content:
maria_engineer: Heads-up — I want to onboard text-xyz v2.3 into the model catalog and pin it as `text-xyz@v2.3` for staging. Planning deploy tomorrow 10:30 PT, canary 10% for 2 hours, then promote to 100% if smoke checks pass. :rocket:

sam_platform: SGTM. I'll run the rollout and monitor. Can you drop the exact smoke checklist and rollback tag? I'll prep the deploy job and make sure Dedicated pools are available.

maria_engineer: Smoke checklist (short):
1) run unit evals + golden prompt suite (`eval/golds/staging`)
2) end-to-end inference sanity (100 sample prompts) — check correctness regressions
3) p50/p95 latency against baseline (expect <= baseline + 15ms)
4) token-level cost sanity (no huge jumps)
5) quick fuzz tests to catch OOMs

Also need `rollback: text-xyz@v2.2` pinned in the catalog so we can flip quickly. Config snippet for catalog entry: 

```
model: text-xyz
version: v2.3
pin: text-xyz@v2.3
fallback: text-xyz@v2.2
canary: 0.10
monitoring: enabled
```

carla_sre: I'll be on standby for the rollout window. Please add the oncall alias `@eng-oncall` in the deploy job so page rules apply. Also add a simple smoke playbook in the thread that SRE can run quickly.

maria_engineer: Good call. Adding short runbook below: 
- Step 1: Verify deploy job completed without error in deploy logs (`/deploys/1718123*`).
- Step 2: Hit `/v1/generate` with the 100-sample set; check 5 random samples for correctness.
- Step 3: Check latency dashboard (console -> models -> text-xyz -> staging) for p95 spike.
- Step 4: If p95 > baseline+30ms OR >1% errors, trigger rollback.
- Step 5: If no regressions at 2hr mark, promote to 100%.

jun_research: Quick note: v2.3 changed tokenizer behavior slightly — outputs are often 1 token shorter on summaries. We should include that in golden checks to avoid false positives. I'll attach a small diff of expected tokens in the eval harness.

maria_engineer: Thanks — include that in the eval script. Also, can we pin the latency SLO threshold in the catalog meta so Console shows it? Something like `slo_latency_p95_ms: 220`.

sam_platform: Done. I updated the deploy job to: 10:30 PT start, 10% canary, 2h wait, health checks every 2m. I also added `@eng-oncall` and `ops-bot` notifications. I'll kick it off and post the deploy link.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: `deploy-1718123456-text-xyz-v2.3`. Triggered by sam_platform. Expected start: 1718127000.

carla_sre: I'll watch console and leave notes in the incident chat if anything weird. If we need to rollback, who executes the toggle?

sam_platform: I will do the toggle (quick catalog pin swap) unless SRE wants to do it. Procedure: `catalog set-pin text-xyz text-xyz@v2.2 --force`. I'll post the exact command in the deploy log before starting.

maria_engineer: Thanks. One more ask — please don't promote to dedicated production until we see no regressions for 24h on staging. We can promote to prod-dedicated in a separate window.

jun_research: ACK on 24h hold. I'll run the extended eval overnight and drop results here.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 10:25 PT — 5 minutes until deploy window for `text-xyz v2.3`.

sam_platform: Deploy started. Link: https://console.redwood.dev/deploys/deploy-1718123456-text-xyz-v2.3

maria_engineer: Running golden checks now. Posting first batch results in ~20m.

carla_sre: Observability looks clean so far. No error spikes. p95 ~ baseline + 8ms. :thumbsup:

jun_research: Eval harness shows length differences but quality comparable. Attaching diff (inline): `median_length_delta: -1 token`

sam_platform: Canary at 10% steady for 30m. No anomalies in logs. Keeping on watch for 2hr mark.

maria_engineer: All smoke checks passed — no regressions in golden suite, latency within limit, cost stable. Approved to promote to 100% at +2h.

deploy-bot: Promotion job queued: `promote-1718123456-text-xyz-v2.3`

sam_platform: Promoted to 100%. Catalog pin is now `text-xyz@v2.3`. Keeping the 24h observation hold for prod-dedicated.

carla_sre: Marking this as green in the runbook. No post-deploy incidents.

maria_engineer: Great work — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the eval report and a short note for release notes. :confetti_ball:
